key_concepts: FaultFinder app identifies the nearest active fault system
Earthquake risk depends on proximity to active fault traces
Community earthquake risk factors include old buildings and dense population
Earthquake focus is located within Earth's crust
Earthquake epicenter and focus are distinct concepts
Increasing force at the focus increases surface shaking and damage
Underwater earthquakes can disturb ocean water
Historical earthquakes have recorded location, date, magnitude, and impacts
Tectonic plate movements contribute to major earthquakes
Earthquake preparedness can reduce community risk
